blueMageActions.description: Grants Cold Fog to self. / Duration: 5s / Effect changes to Touch of Frost if damage is taken. / Touch of Frost Effect: Action changes from Cold Fog to White Death / Duration: 15s / / White Death / Deals ice damage with a potency of 400. / Additional Effect: Deep Freeze / Duration: 10s / Can only be executed while under the effect of Touch of Frost .

blueMageActions.name: Stotram
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 140 to all nearby enemies. / Action effect changes, restoring own HP and the HP of all nearby party members when you are under the effect of Aetheric Mimicry: Healer . / Cure Potency: 300

blueMageActions.name: Saintly Beam
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 100 to target and all enemies nearby it. / Potency increases to 500 when used against undead enemies .

blueMageActions.name: Feculent Flood
blueMageActions.description: Deals earth damage to all enemies in a straight line before you with a potency of 220 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies.

blueMageActions.name: Angel's Snack
blueMageActions.description: Restores own HP and the HP of all nearby party members. / Cure Potency: 400 / Additional Effect: Grants healing over time effect when you are under the effect of Aetheric Mimicry: Healer / Cure Potency: 200 / Duration: 15s / Shares a recast timer with Dragon Force and Matra Magic .

blueMageActions.name: Chelonian Gate
blueMageActions.description: Summons a chelonian gate, reducing damage taken by 20%. / Duration: 10s / Additional Effect: Grants Auspicious Trance after taking damage equal to 30% of maximum HP / Auspicious Trance Effect: Action changes from Chelonian Gate to Divine Cataract / Chelonian Gate effect ends upon using another action or moving (including facing a different direction). / Auspicious Trance ends upon losing the effect of Chelonian Gate . / Shares a recast timer with The Rose of Destruction and Ruby Dynamics . / / Divine Cataract / Deals water damage to all nearby enemies with a potency of 500 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Potency increases to 1,000 when you are under the effect of Aetheric Mimicry: Tank . / Can only be executed when under the effect of Auspicious Trance .

blueMageActions.name: The Rose of Destruction
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 400. / Additional Effect: 10-yalm knockback / Shares a recast timer with Chelonian Gate and Ruby Dynamics .

blueMageActions.name: Basic Instinct
blueMageActions.description: Increases movement speed by 30%, and healing magic potency and damage dealt by 100%. Also ignores the damage penalty inflicted by Mighty Guard . / Can only be used in duties intended for two or more players while playing alone, while no other party members are in the instance, or when all party members are incapacitated. Effect ends when joined by one or more party members.

blueMageActions.name: Ultravibration
blueMageActions.description: KOs all nearby enemies afflicted with Deep Freeze or Petrification . Has no effect on enemies whose level is higher than your own, and certain others. / Shares a recast timer with Level 5 Death .

blueMageActions.name: Blaze
blueMageActions.description: Deals ice damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 220 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies.

blueMageActions.name: Mustard Bomb
blueMageActions.description: Deals fire damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 220 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: Enemies affected by Lightheaded suffer damage over time / Potency: 50 / Duration: 15s

blueMageActions.name: Dragon Force
blueMageActions.description: Reduces damage taken by 20%. / Duration: 15s / Increases damage reduction to 40% when you are under the effect of Aetheric Mimicry: Tank . / Shares a recast timer with Angel's Snack and Matra Magic .

blueMageActions.name: Aetherial Spark
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 50 to all enemies in a straight line before you. / Additional Effect: Unaspected damage over time / Potency: 50 / Duration: 15s

blueMageActions.name: Hydro Pull
blueMageActions.description: Deals water damage to all nearby enemies with a potency of 220 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: Draw-in

blueMageActions.name: Malediction of Water
blueMageActions.description: Deals water damage to all enemies in a straight line before you with a potency of 200 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: 10-yalm knockback to all enemies and party members in range / Cannot be used outside of combat or when target is suffering from certain enfeeblements.

blueMageActions.name: Choco Meteor
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 200 for the first enemy, and 50% for all remaining enemies. / Potency increases to 300 when partied with your personal chocobo.

blueMageActions.name: Matra Magic
blueMageActions.description: Deals an unaspected eightfold attack, each hit with a potency of 50. / Potency is increased to 100 when you are under the effect of Aetheric Mimicry: DPS . / Shares a recast timer with Angel's Snack and Dragon Force .

blueMageActions.name: Peripheral Synthesis
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage to all enemies in a straight line before you with a potency of 220 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Potency increased to 400 when target becomes afflicted with Lightheaded . / Additional Effect: Inflicts Lightheaded / Duration: 5s / Repeated use of this action in a short period will reduce the additional effect's duration, eventually rendering targets immune to Lightheaded .

blueMageActions.name: Both Ends
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage with a potency of 600 to all nearby enemies. / Shares a recast timer with Nightbloom .

blueMageActions.name: Phantom Flurry
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage over time with a potency of 200 to all enemies in a cone before you. / Duration: 5s / Executing Phantom Flurry again before its effect expires deals unaspected damage to all enemies in a cone before you with a potency of 600 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Effect ends upon using an action other than Phantom Flurry or moving (including facing a different direction).

blueMageActions.name: Nightbloom
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage to all nearby enemies with a potency of 400 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: Unaspected damage over time / Potency: 75 / Duration: 60s / Shares a recast timer with Both Ends .

blueMageActions.name: Goblin Punch
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage with a potency of 120. / 220 when executed in front of a target. / Potency is increased to 220 when you are under the effect of Mighty Guard . / 320 when executed in front of a target while you are under the effect of Mighty Guard .

blueMageActions.name: Right Round
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage with a potency of 110 to all nearby enemies. / Additional Effect: 10-yalm knockback to all enemies and party members in range / Cannot be used outside of combat or when target is suffering from certain enfeeblements.

blueMageActions.name: Schiltron
blueMageActions.description: Counters enemies with unaspected damage every time you suffer physical damage. / Counter Potency: 50 / Duration: 15s / Potency is increased to 100 when you are under the effect of Aetheric Mimicry: Tank . / Effect cannot be stacked with Veil of the Whorl or Ice Spikes .

blueMageActions.name: Rehydration
blueMageActions.description: Restores own HP. / Cure Potency: 600

blueMageActions.name: Breath of Magic
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage over time with a potency of 120 to all enemies in a cone before you. / Duration: 60s / Only one effect inflicted by this action can be active at a time.

blueMageActions.name: Wild Rage
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage to all nearby enemies with a potency of 500 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Consumes 50% of your maximum HP when executed.

blueMageActions.name: Peat Pelt
blueMageActions.description: Deals earth damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 100 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: Afflicts target with Begrimed / Begrimed Effect: Earth damage over time / Potency: 10 / Duration: 9s

blueMageActions.name: Deep Clean
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage to all nearby enemies with a potency of 220 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: Grants one stack of Spick-and-span for each enemy afflicted with Begrimed . The Begrimed effect is also removed. / Maximum Stacks: 6 / Spick-and-span Effect: Regen / Cure Potency: 50 / Cure potency increases up to 300 based on your accumulated stacks of Spick-and-span . / Duration: 15s / Additional stacks of Spick-and-span accumulated while the effect is active will not affect duration.

blueMageActions.name: Ruby Dynamics
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage with a potency of 220 to all enemies before you. / Shares a recast timer with Chelonian Gate and The Rose of Destruction .

blueMageActions.name: Divination Rune
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 100 to all enemies in a cone before you. / Additional Effect: Restores MP

blueMageActions.name: Dimensional Shift
blueMageActions.description: Delivers an attack to all nearby enemies dealing damage equal to 30% of their current HP. / Has no effect on enemies whose level is higher than your own.

blueMageActions.name: Conviction Marcato
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage to all enemies in a straight line before you with a potency of 220 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Potency is increased to 440 when you are under the effect of Winged Redemption .

blueMageActions.name: Force Field
blueMageActions.description: Grants either Physical Vulnerability Down or Magic Vulnerability Down. / Duration: 10s / Physical Vulnerability Down Effect: Reduces physical damage taken by 50% / Magic Vulnerability Down Effect: Reduces magic damage taken by 50% / This action does not share a recast timer with any other actions.

blueMageActions.name: Winged Reprobation
blueMageActions.description: Deals physical damage to all enemies in a straight line before you with a potency of 300 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: Grants one stack of Winged Reprobation and resets this action's recast timer / Maximum Stacks: 4 / Execution at 3 stacks increases potency to 400 and grants one stack of Winged Reprobation , but recast timer will not be reset. / At maximum stacks, Winged Reprobation changes to Winged Redemption . / Winged Redemption Effect: Increases the potency of Conviction Marcato / Duration: 10s / This action does not share a recast timer with any other actions.

blueMageActions.name: Laser Eye
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 220 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: 5-yalm knockback

blueMageActions.name: Candy Cane
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 250 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Additional Effect: Lowers strength and dexterity attributes of target by 10% / Duration: 10s / Additional Effect: Restores 10% of maximum MP / Shares a recast timer with Magic Hammer .

blueMageActions.name: Mortal Flame
blueMageActions.description: Deals fire damage over time with a potency of 40. / Only one effect inflicted by this action can be active at a time. / Has no effect on targets outside of combat. / Effect ends upon target leaving combat.

blueMageActions.name: Sea Shanty
blueMageActions.description: Deals water damage with a potency of 500 to all nearby enemies. / Additional Effect: Potency increases to 1,000 during rain , showers , and thunderstorms

blueMageActions.name: Apokalypsis
blueMageActions.description: Delivers damage over time with a potency of 140 to all enemies in a straight line before you. / Duration: 10s / Effect ends upon using another action or moving (including facing a different direction). / Shares a recast timer with Being Mortal .

blueMageActions.name: Being Mortal
blueMageActions.description: Deals unaspected damage to all nearby enemies with a potency of 800 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies. / Shares a recast timer with Apokalypsis .

blueMageRoleActions.name: Addle
blueMageRoleActions.description: Lowers target's physical damage dealt by 5% and magic damage dealt by 10%. / Duration: 15s

blueMageRoleActions.name: Sleep
blueMageRoleActions.description: Puts target and all nearby enemies to sleep. / Duration: 30s / Cancels auto-attack upon execution.

blueMageRoleActions.name: Lucid Dreaming
blueMageRoleActions.description: Gradually restores own MP. / Potency: 55 / Duration: 21s

blueMageRoleActions.name: Swiftcast
blueMageRoleActions.description: Next spell is cast immediately. / Duration: 10s

blueMageRoleActions.name: Surecast
blueMageRoleActions.description: Spells can be cast without interruption. / Additional Effect: Nullifies most knockback and draw-in effects / Duration: 6s

beastmasterJobActions.name: Capture
beastmasterJobActions.description: Delivers an attack with a potency of 100. / Target cannot be incapacitated by this attack. / Additional Effect: Marks target with Interest Captured / Duration: 120s / Interest Captured Effect: Forges a pact with the targeted beast should you succeed in their subdual / Success is determined upon defeating targets under the effect of Interest Captured . / An entry in the Master's Bestiary will be added upon successful subdual, allowing the beast to be summoned as a familiar. / Success rate is inversely proportional to the target's HP at the time of execution. Furthermore, success rate increases if the target is a lower level than you. / Ineffective against targets whose level is higher than your own.

beastmasterJobActions.name: Beast Mode
beastmasterJobActions.description: Upon using Borrow , changes to an action dependent on Kinship . / Beast Kinship Effect: Action reduces physical vulnerability / Vile Kinship Effect: Action increases block rate / Cloud Kinship Effect: Action bolsters movement / Seed Kinship Effect: Action inflicts poison and weakening effects / Wave Kinship Effect: Action deals ranged magic damage to a single target / Scale Kinship Effect: Action absorbs magic damage / Soul Kinship Effect: Action delivers an attack that interrupts a single target / Ash Kinship Effect: Action removes a detrimental effect

beastmasterJobActions.name: Borrow
beastmasterJobActions.description: Borrows aether from your summoned familiar to gain Kinship according to its classification. / Beastkin Familiar Effect: Grants Beast Kinship / Vilekin Familiar Effect: Grants Vile Kinship / Cloudkin Familiar Effect: Grants Cloud Kinship / Seedkin Familiar Effect: Grants Seed Kinship / Wavekin Familiar Effect: Grants Wave Kinship / Scalekin Familiar Effect: Grants Scale Kinship / Soulkin Familiar Effect: Grants Soul Kinship / Ashkin Familiar Effect: Grants Ash Kinship / Changes Beast Mode into an action according to your familiar's classification. / Duration: 90s / Expiration timer is halted while your familiar is summoned. / Additional Effect: Grants Lingering Vantage / Duration: 60s / Can only be executed while under the effect of One with Nature .

beastmasterJobActions.name: Shield Charge
beastmasterJobActions.description: Rushes forward and delivers an attack to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 300 / Maximum Charges: 3 / Cannot be executed while bound.

beastmasterJobActions.name: Rally
beastmasterJobActions.description: Spends all stacks of Mastered Instinct to increase TP Gauge . / Standard TP Gauge Increase: 40 / Each stack of Mastered Instinct increases TP Gauge by 70. / Can only be executed while in combat.

beastmasterJobActions.name: Rallying Cheer
beastmasterJobActions.description: Spends all stacks of Natural Instinct to increase Familiar TP Gauge . / Standard Familiar TP Gauge Increase: 30 / Each stack of Natural Instinct increases Familiar TP Gauge by 70. / Can only be executed while in combat.

beastmasterJobActions.name: Brutal Rage
beastmasterJobActions.description: Rushes forward and delivers an attack with a potency of 1,200 to target and all enemies nearby it. / All TP will be expended upon execution. / TP Gauge Cost: 250 / Instinctual Affinity: Sunstrider / Additional Effect: Grants Sunstrider / Duration: 7s / Instinctual skills may be executed sequentially to deal additional damage, which is determined by the skill that completes the combo. / Executing a Sunstrider skill while under the effect of Moonstalker will complete the infinitive combo Universality , dealing greater additional damage. / Cannot be executed while bound. / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Avalanche Axe changes to Brutal Rage when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterJobActions.name: Hawkish Talons
beastmasterJobActions.description: Rushes forward and delivers an attack with a potency of 1,200 to target and all enemies nearby it. / All TP will be expended upon execution. / TP Gauge Cost: 250 / Instinctual Affinity: Moonstalker / Additional Effect: Grants Moonstalker / Duration: 7s / Instinctual skills may be executed sequentially to deal additional damage, which is determined by the skill that completes the combo. / Executing a Moonstalker skill while under the effect of Sunstrider will complete the infinitive combo Universality , dealing greater additional damage. / Cannot be executed while bound. / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Mistral Axe changes to Hawkish Talons when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterJobActions.name: Risen Fall
beastmasterJobActions.description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 1,200 to target and all enemies nearby it. / All TP will be expended upon execution. / TP Gauge Cost: 250 / Instinctual Affinity: Sunstrider / Additional Effect: Grants Sunstrider / Duration: 7s / Instinctual skills may be executed sequentially to deal additional damage, which is determined by the skill that completes the combo. / Executing a Sunstrider skill while under the effect of Moonstalker will complete the infinitive combo Universality , dealing greater additional damage. / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Spinning Axe changes to Risen Fall when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterJobActions.name: Calamity
beastmasterJobActions.description: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 1,200 to all enemies in a straight line. / All TP will be expended upon execution. / TP Gauge Cost: 250 / Instinctual Affinity: Moonstalker / Additional Effect: Grants Moonstalker / Duration: 7s / Instinctual skills may be executed sequentially to deal additional damage, which is determined by the skill that completes the combo. / Executing a Moonstalker skill while under the effect of Sunstrider will complete the infinitive combo Universality , dealing greater additional damage. / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Gale Axe changes to Calamity when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterInstinctActions.name: Beastskin
beastmasterInstinctActions.description: Reduces physical damage taken by 25% and increases critical hit rate by 5%. / Duration: 30s / Can only be executed while under the effect of Beast Kinship . / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Beast Mode changes to Beastskin when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterInstinctActions.name: Vileskin
beastmasterInstinctActions.description: Nullifies most knockback and draw-in effects and increases block rate to 100%. / Increases TP Gauge by 12 for each block. / Duration: 15s / Can only be executed while under the effect of Vile Kinship . / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Beast Mode changes to Vileskin when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterInstinctActions.name: Cloud Skim
beastmasterInstinctActions.description: Move quickly in the selected direction. / Increases evasion by 5%. / Duration: 60s / Can only be executed while under the effect of Cloud Kinship . / Cannot be executed while bound. / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Beast Mode changes to Cloud Skim when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterInstinctActions.name: Seedsower
beastmasterInstinctActions.description: Afflicts nearby enemies with Seeds Sown . / Seeds Sown Effect: Reduces damage dealt by 10% and inflicts toxins that cause damage over time / Potency: 25 / Duration: 60s / Can only be executed while under the effect of Seed Kinship . / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Beast Mode changes to Seedsower when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterInstinctActions.name: Quelling Wave
beastmasterInstinctActions.description: Deals water damage with a potency of 350. / Additional Effect: Increases TP Gauge by 10 / Additional Effect: Removes one beneficial status from target, thereby increasing TP Gauge by 50 / Can only be executed while under the effect of Wave Kinship . / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Beast Mode changes to Quelling Wave when requirements for execution are met.

beastmasterInstinctActions.name: Scaleskin

beastmasterInstinctActions.name: Scouring Ash
beastmasterInstinctActions.description: Removes a single detrimental effect from self or targeted party member. / Recovers 10% of maximum HP and increases TP Gauge by 100 upon removal. / Can only be executed while under the effect of Ash Kinship . / ※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar. / ※ Beast Mode changes to Scouring Ash when requirements for execution are met.
